newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Apr-Sep minivehicle sales fall 1.5 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Apr-Sep minivehicle sales fall 1.5 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japanese domestic sales of minivehicles -- those with engines up to 660 cc -- fell 1.5 percent in the six months to the end of September from a year earlier to 829,084, the Japan Mini Vehicle Association said.
Of the total, sales of mini passenger cars in the April-September half year rose 5.8 percent from a year earlier to 465,049, while sales of mini commercial vehicles fell 9.4 percent to 364,035.

The association said Japan's sales of motorcycles with engines from 126 cc to 250 cc fell 17.4 percent from a year earlier to 53,983 in the April-September half year.
